proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P transport IPC registration/deregistration to support multi-segment buffers (segment-wise export/import, proxy FD batch conversion, per-connection handle tracking, and cleanup). Added memory-module review because allocation/registration ownership semantics changed in shared HG memory free/unmap helpers (multi-segment map/unmap, granularity/range handling, and release behavior), which is independently substantive.
